colt.line: So then I went and bought myself a Colt 45
stanza: So then I went and bought myself a Colt 45
Called a Peacemaker, but I never knew why
Never knew why, I didn't understand
Mama said, "The pistol is the devil's right hand"

colt.line: And all that I learned from a Colt 45
stanza: Son I stood in that street before it was paved
I learned the shoot or be shot before I could shave
And I did it all for the money and the fame
Noble was nothing but feeling no shame
And nothing was sacred but staying alive
And all that I learned from a Colt 45

volt.songTitle: Tell the Devil I’m Gettin’ There as Fast as I Can
volt.line: I met her in L.A., we was openin' for Son Volt
stanza: I met her in L.A., we was openin' for Son Volt
She had eyes mascara'd like Eva Green’s
She sparkled with wildness like the blue yonder
She'd done a time in darkness and was two years clean
She wears an old leather jacket, it was made by Irish saints
And boots engraved with skulls and thorns
She got her ink in Tulsa, still she don't like red-dirt bands
Bein' in love with her is like living in a thunderstorm
